description: An interpolation missing its closing brace in a heredoc is a syntax error
notes: The only mistake is the missing }. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside interpolations (see the disputed interpolation-allows-newlines-in-heredoc), so it reports the closing EOT line as extra characters after the expression, while a parser that doesn't allow newlines there fails at the newline instead. No heredoc input avoids this, because a line break always follows the unclosed expression.
reference_error: Expected a closing brace to end the interpolation expression
